## How to collaborate in an agent-driven environment {.smaller}

<!--
Reflections on why it is hard, from Sam's steers. Issue #9.
-->

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- More changes than any of us can read
- Hard to tell what a person wrote from what an agent wrote
- Hard to know what the other person's agents changed, and why
- Changes are cheap to write
- Checking them costs as much as before
- People have different levels of access to agents
